behaviors.name: Drift
behaviors.intent: Drift slowly along +X at a gentle speed unique to this cloud; past x = 40, wrap back to x = -40.
behaviors.source:
behavior Drift
  intent "Drift slowly along +X at a gentle speed unique to this cloud; past x = 40, wrap back to x = -40."
  var speed = 0.6

  on start
    -- mix in the id so every cloud gets its own pace
    speed = 0.4 + ((random() + self.id * 0.618) % 1) * 0.4
  end

  on tick
    move self by (speed * dt, 0, 0)
    if self.position.x > 40 then
      self.position.x = -40
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Hover
behaviors.intent: Float softly around the spot where it started, tracing a slow lazy loop with its own size, speed and timing so the swarm never moves in sync.
behaviors.source:
behavior Hover
  intent "Float softly around the spot where it started, tracing a slow lazy loop with its own size, speed and timing so the swarm never moves in sync."
  var home = (0, 0, 0)
  var p = 0
  var r = 0.5
  var a = 0.8
  var b = 1.3

  on start
    home = self.position
    -- per-firefly variety (id mixed in so each one differs)
    let k = (random() + self.id * 0.618) % 1
    p = k * 2 * pi
    r = 0.3 + ((random() + self.id * 0.414) % 1) * 0.5
    a = 0.6 + k * 0.6
    b = 1.1 + ((random() + self.id * 0.273) % 1) * 0.8
  end

  on tick
    self.position = home + (sin(time * a + p) * r, sin(time * b + p) * 0.3, cos(time * a + p) * r)
  end
end

behaviors.intent: Turn the windmill blades steadily around their hub (local Z axis) at 40 degrees per second.
behaviors.source:
behavior Spin
  intent "Turn the windmill blades steadily around their hub (local Z axis) at 40 degrees per second."
  var speed = 40

  on tick
    rotate self by (0, 0, speed * dt)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Beacon
behaviors.intent: Make the lighthouse lamp breathe: its warm glow swells and fades in a steady pulse, like a beacon calling ships home.
behaviors.source:
behavior Beacon
  intent "Make the lighthouse lamp breathe: its warm glow swells and fades in a steady pulse, like a beacon calling ships home."
  var rate = 3

  on tick
    let pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(time * rate)
    self.mesh.emissive = color(1, 0.8, 0.4, 0.4 + 0.4 * pulse)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Cruise
behaviors.intent: Sail in a slow circle around the island center, keeping the distance and altitude it started at, bobbing gently up and down and always pointing its nose the way it is flying.
behaviors.source:
behavior Cruise
  intent "Sail in a slow circle around the island center, keeping the distance and altitude it started at, bobbing gently up and down and always pointing its nose the way it is flying."
  var radius = 12
  var baseY = 8
  var speed = 0.08
  var phase = 0

  on start
    let p = self.position
    radius = length(vec(p.x, 0, p.z))
    baseY = p.y
    -- all airships share one angular speed (radians per second) so ships on opposite
    -- sides of the island never catch up and collide; only the bob timing differs
    phase = ((random() + self.id * 0.414) % 1) * 2 * pi
  end

  on tick
    let p = self.position
    let w = speed * dt
    -- rotate the current spot around the island's vertical axis by a tiny angle
    let nx = p.x * cos(w) - p.z * sin(w)
    let nz = p.x * sin(w) + p.z * cos(w)
    let flat = normalize(vec(nx, 0, nz)) * radius
    let y = baseY + sin(time * 0.8 + phase) * 0.35
    self.position = vec(flat.x, y, flat.z)
    -- face a point a little further along the circle
    let ahead = 0.15
    let ax = flat.x * cos(ahead) - flat.z * sin(ahead)
    let az = flat.x * sin(ahead) + flat.z * cos(ahead)
    look self at vec(ax, y, az)
    -- the balloon's nose points along its local +X, so turn a quarter so the nose (not -Z) leads
    self.rotation.y = self.rotation.y + 90
  end
end

behaviors.name: Stroll
behaviors.intent: Pip ambles back and forth between the plaza and the path toward the windmill, turning to face where he walks and pausing for a moment to look around at each end.
behaviors.source:
behavior Stroll
  intent "Pip ambles back and forth between the plaza and the path toward the windmill, turning to face where he walks and pausing for a moment to look around at each end."
  var pointA = (0, 0.45, 0)
  var pointB = (-5.6, 0.45, -4.9)
  var target = (0, 0.45, 0)
  var walkSpeed = 1.1
  var rest = 0

  on start
    pointA = self.position
    target = pointB
  end

  on tick
    if rest > 0 then
      rest = rest - dt
      if rest <= 0 then
        -- done resting: head for the other end
        if length(target - pointA) < 0.1 then
          target = pointB
        else
          target = pointA
        end
      end
    else
      let goal = vec(target.x, self.position.y, target.z)
      if length(goal - self.position) < 0.08 then
        rest = 1.5 + random() * 1.5
      else
        look self at goal
        move self toward goal at walkSpeed
      end
    end
  end
end
